A [[Gender|female]]<ref name="SC 105 SB" /> '''Muun''' was a member of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan|Banking Clan]] in the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 105" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref>{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the individual was on an official business trip to the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]], accommodated in<ref name="SC 105" /> [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]].<ref name="GR-FF-001420">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/bj8gqtnvm799njt6mjc6t|text=GR-FF-001420|date=2024-12-23}}</ref> In their spare time, the woman indulged themselves in [[hotel]] services. One [[Standard day|day]], as they took a [[mud bath]] with a [[Color|white]] [[Clothing|towel]] on their head in the company of<ref name="SC 105" /> a [[Unidentified male Muun|male colleague]],<ref name="SC 105 SB" /> two<ref name="SC 105" /> [[Unidentified security officer|security officers]]<ref name="SC 105 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> came up, asking if the guests had seen [[Jod Na Nawood]]. Both of the [[Muun]]s, however, denied having seen him.<ref name="SC 105 />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Gender|female]]<ref name="SC 105 SB" /> [[Muun]] made their debut in "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]," the fifth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 105" /> which premiered on [[December 24]], [[2024]].<ref>{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
